result.document_summary: San Francisco Rent Board web page listing current allowable annual rent increase, security deposit interest, and eviction relocation payment rates for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027.
result.notes: The page is a rate table, not statutory text. Two San Francisco rules in scope are supported: the annual allowable rent increase (rent_increase_limits) and the eviction relocation payment schedule (just_cause_eviction). The 4.2% security deposit interest rate is an interest rate on tenant deposits (security_deposits), but the page states no operative rule beyond the rate itself and gives no governing citation or coverage, so it is noted in the rent/relocation records' context rather than as a separate rule. Capital improvement pass-through rates, Rent Board fees, and uncompensated labor rates are out of scope. The page does not state coverage criteria or exemptions, so coverage is left empty; the page names S.F. Admin. Code ch. 37 (Rent Ordinance Sections 37.9A and 37.9C) as the underlying law. Effective dates are the rate-period start dates stated on the page.

rules.title: San Francisco annual allowable rent increase
rules.requirement: The Rent Board sets an annual allowable rent increase for covered units; for March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 the allowable increase is 1.6%.
rules.quoted_span:
Allowable Rent Increase:
1.6% for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027
rules.coverage_text: The page does not state which units are covered; it publishes the allowable annual increase under San Francisco's rent ordinance.

rules.title: San Francisco eviction relocation payments
rules.requirement: Landlords must pay relocation to tenants evicted for owner/relative move-in, demolition/permanent removal, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation, with separate higher amounts for Ellis Act evictions and a daily amount for temporary displacement under 20 days. For notices served 3/01/26–2/28/27 the per-tenant amount is $8,245 (max $24,733 per unit, plus $5,497 for each elderly, disabled, or minor-child household).
rules.key_value: $8,245 per tenant; max $24,733 per unit; +$5,497 per elderly/disabled/minor-child household (Ellis Act: $11,110.05 per tenant, max $33,330.13)
rules.quoted_span: Relocation Payments for Evictions based on Owner/Relative Move-in OR Demolition/Permanent Removal of Unit from Housing Use OR Temporary Capital Improvement Work* OR Substantial Rehabilitation
rules.coverage_text: Applies to tenants given a notice of termination of tenancy on the listed grounds; the page does not state building-level coverage tests.
rules.interaction: Relocation for temporary capital improvement evictions of less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 rather than Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
